description: greplost: keep the committed structure map (.greplost/) current and point agents at it before they grep.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1 && greplost hook session-start || bunx greplost hook session-start'
sh -c 'command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1 && greplost hook pre-tool-use || bunx greplost hook pre-tool-use'
sh -c 'command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1 && greplost hook post-tool-use || bunx greplost hook post-tool-use'
sh -c 'command -v greplost >/dev/null 2>&1 && greplost hook stop || bunx greplost hook stop'
